## What Changed

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue if there is one.

## Verification

List relevant test/build commands and results. Distinguish native UI checks, demo data, and live-provider evidence. State anything unverified.

## Contributor Checklist

- [ ] Read [Contributing](https://github.com/lancelarsen/AI-Token-Scrooge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the applicable design, architecture, integration, and testing guides
- [ ] Preserved existing account, persistence, and credential-isolation behavior
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation and TODOs
- [ ] Checked Title Case for headings and short labels, Markdown formatting, and links
- [ ] Included no credentials, private provider responses, personal databases, or unredacted screenshots
- [ ] For UI changes: named the existing reference control, rebuilt/restarted the app, and checked desktop and compact layouts
- [ ] For providers: supplied sanitized source evidence and mapping, failure, identity, and lifecycle verification

Mark non-applicable checklist items as N/A in the description rather than implying they were tested.
